<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">30.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Fair value measurement</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The disclosure of the fair value of
financial instruments is based on the following fair value hierarchy:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Level 1:</B> Quoted, unadjusted prices in active markets
for identical assets or liabilities.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Level 2:</B> Inputs other than quoted prices included within
Level 1 that are observable for the asset or liability, either directly or indirectly.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Level 3:</B> Unobservable inputs for the asset or liability.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The compound embedded derivative
separated from the convertible loan notes is measured at fair value through profit or loss and is categorised within Level 3 of the fair
value hierarchy. It is valued using a probability-weighted scenario model whose significant unobservable inputs are the probabilities
of pre-maturity conversion, conversion at maturity and exit settlement, with issue-date values calibrated to third-party bank quotes for
equivalent non-convertible debt.</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">35.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Explanation of transition to IFRS</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">These are the group&rsquo;s first consolidated
financial statements prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB),
and IFRS 1 <I>First-time Adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards </I>has been applied. For periods up to and including
the year ended 31 March 2025, the company prepared its financial statements in accordance with FRS 102 (previous GAAP). The date of transition
is 1 April 2024. In preparing its opening IFRS statement of financial position and comparative information, the company has adjusted amounts
reported previously under FRS 102. This note explains the principal adjustments and their effect on the company&rsquo;s financial position,
financial performance and cash flows.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Optional exemptions applied</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Lease definition (IFRS 1.D9). The
company has assessed whether contracts existing at the date of transition contain a lease on the basis of facts and circumstances at that
date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Leases (IFRS 1.D9B and D9D). Lease
liabilities for leases previously classified as operating leases have been measured at the present value of the remaining lease payments
at 1 April 2024, discounted using the incremental borrowing rate at that date, with right-of-use assets measured at an amount equal to
the lease liability, adjusted for prepaid or accrued lease payments. The D9D practical expedients, including a single discount rate for
portfolios of similar leases and the exclusion of leases ending within twelve months of transition, have been applied where relevant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Deemed cost (IFRS 1.D5-D8). Not
applied: previous GAAP measured property, plant and equipment under the cost model, so full retrospective application of IAS 16 produces
the same carrying amounts.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Borrowing costs (IFRS 1.D23). IAS
23 is applied to borrowing costs relating to qualifying assets for which the commencement date for capitalisation is on or after 1 April
2024.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Share-based payments (IFRS 1.D2).
The exemption is available only for awards that vested before the date of transition. The company&rsquo;s CSOP options were unvested at
1 April 2024, so the exemption does not apply and IFRS 2 has been applied to those awards in full.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">35.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Explanation of transition to IFRS (continued)</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Mandatory exceptions applied</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Estimates at 1 April 2024 and 31
March 2025 are consistent with those made at the same dates under FRS 102, adjusted only for differences in accounting policies (IFRS
1.14-17). Classification and measurement of financial assets is assessed on the facts at the date of transition (IFRS 1.B8-B8C). The expected
credit loss requirements are applied using reasonable and supportable information available at transition without undue cost or effort
(IFRS 1.B8D). Whether an embedded derivative is separated from its host contract is assessed on the conditions at the later of the date
the company first became a party to the contract and the date a reassessment is required by IFRS 9 (IFRS 1.B9). Derecognition of financial
assets and liabilities is applied prospectively from the date of transition (IFRS 1.B2-B3); hedge accounting and non-controlling interests
are not applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Adjustments arising on transition</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">(a)&nbsp;Convertible
loan notes (IAS 32 / IFRS 9). The conversion feature fails the fixed-for-fixed condition, so the notes are a liability in full and the
FRS 102 convertible loan note reserve reverses. The conversion features are a single embedded derivative at fair value through profit
or loss and the host is carried at amortised cost. Equity effect &pound;(1.7) million at 1 April 2024 and &pound;(0.6)m at 31 March 2025;
FY25 finance cost &pound;1.1m lower.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">(b)&nbsp;Share-based
payments (IFRS 2). The unvested options are expensed over their vesting periods at grant-date fair value, with employer payroll taxes
provided on the unapproved options. The charge is credited to contributed surplus, so the equity effect is limited to the NIC provision
(&pound;5k at 1 April 2024; &pound;18k at 31 March 2025); FY25 loss &pound;786k higher.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">(c)&nbsp;Leases
(IFRS 16). Vehicle leases are recognised as right-of-use assets and lease liabilities; hire purchase obligations other than the asset-backed
financing are presented as lease liabilities. Equity effect nil at 1 April 2024 and &pound;(12)k at 31 March 2025.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">(d)&nbsp;Asset-backed
financing (IFRS 16.98-103). The sale-and-hire-purchase-back arrangements do not transfer control of the plant, so the plant remains in
property, plant and equipment and the proceeds (&pound;11,996k in FY25 and &pound;8,692k in FY26) are secured borrowings; the FRS 102
deferred loss reverses. All arrangements post-date 1 April 2024. Equity effect &pound;0.4 million at 31 March 2025; FY25 loss &pound;0.4m
lower.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">(e)&nbsp;Presentation
(IFRS 15 / IAS 20). Grant income and damages are presented within finance income (loss) and other; accrued and deferred income as contract
assets and liabilities; and the hydrogen production units held for the joint venture as inventories. No effect on equity or the loss.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"> (f) Expected credit losses (IFRS 9). Not material at any date presented; no adjustment.</P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">(g)&nbsp;R&amp;D
credit (IAS 20) and deferred tax (IAS 12). The R&amp;D credit is government assistance: for FY25, &pound;588k is deducted from intangible
assets and &pound;196k recognised in other income, and the receivable is shown as R&amp;D credit receivable (note 12). Equity effect &pound;(588)k
at 31 March 2025. No net deferred tax is recognised at any date: the liability on fixed asset timing differences is covered by unrecognised
losses (note 18).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">(h)&nbsp;Borrowing
costs (IAS 23). The difference from the interest capitalised under FRS 102 is c.&pound;0.1 million in aggregate and is not adjusted.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 12pt"><B>GeoPura Ltd.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">3 months
ended June 30 2026</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>Unaudited (Tabular amounts expressed in thousands
of pounds sterling, except number of options and per option amounts)</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: justify">1.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">General information</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">GeoPura Ltd (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;)
is a private company limited by shares, incorporated in England and Wales, with its registered office in Nottingham, United Kingdom. The
unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements comprise the Company and its subsidiary GeoPura (Europe) ApS (together,
the &ldquo;Group&rdquo;). The Group supplies hydrogen-fuelled power as a service through its fleet of hydrogen power units, sells hydrogen
power units and hydrogen production equipment, and holds a 50% interest in HyMarnham Power Ltd, a joint venture producing hydrogen at
High Marnham. On June 23, 2026 the Company&rsquo;s shareholders agreed to sell the Company to Ballard Power Systems Inc.; the acquisition was
completed on August 28, 2026 (note 21).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: justify">2.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Basis of preparation and statement of compliance</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">These condensed consolidated interim
financial statements have been prepared in accordance with IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting as issued by the International Accounting
Standards Board. They do not include all of the information required for full annual financial statements and should be read together
with the Group&rsquo;s financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The financial statements for the
interim period ended June 30, 2026 were authorised for issue under a resolution of the directors on November 9, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The financial statements are prepared
on the historical cost basis, except for the embedded derivative within the convertible loan notes, which is measured at fair value through
profit or loss, and share-based compensation, which is measured at grant-date fair value. They are presented in pounds sterling, the functional
currency of the Company, rounded to the nearest thousand; the subsidiary&rsquo;s functional currency is the Danish krone and exchange differences
on its translation are recognised in other comprehensive income.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Going concern</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The company has been a wholly-owned
subsidiary of Ballard Power Systems Inc. since August 28, 2026. Forecasts for at least twelve months from approval show that capital expenditure
and working capital depend on parent funding; Ballard has confirmed it will provide the support needed to meet liabilities as they fall
due. The financial statements are therefore prepared on the going concern basis.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: justify">3.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Material accounting policies</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The accounting policies applied
are those set out in the Group&rsquo;s financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The Group&rsquo;s 50% interest in HyMarnham Power Ltd, which
commenced operations in April 2026, is accounted for using the equity method from that date (note 9). The investment is initially recognised
at cost and subsequently adjusted to recognise the Group&rsquo;s share of the joint venture&rsquo;s profit or loss and other comprehensive income.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The Group also considers long-term interests that,
in substance, form part of its net investment in the joint venture when determining the extent to which the Group&rsquo;s share of losses is
recognised. Once the Group&rsquo;s interest in the joint venture has been reduced to nil, additional losses are recognised only to the extent
that the Group has incurred legal or constructive obligations or made payments on behalf of the joint venture.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Loans to the joint venture that do not form part of
the Group&rsquo;s net investment are accounted for separately as financial assets.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Standards issued but not yet effective which may be
relevant to the company are: IFRS 18 Presentation and Disclosure in Financial Statements (effective 1 January 2027), which replaces IAS
1 and introduces defined subtotals and disclosure of management-defined performance measures, the company is assessing its impact; and
IFRS 19 Subsidiaries without Public Accountability: Disclosures (effective 1 January 2027), which the company&rsquo;s Danish subsidiary
may be eligible to apply in its own reporting. The company does not plan to adopt these standards early.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Notes to Consolidated Financial

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">9.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Investment in and loans to joint venture</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">HyMarnham Power Ltd is a joint
venture developing a hydrogen production facility at High Marnham. In April 2026 the Group subscribed &pound;2.0 million of equity and
subordinated debt and advanced &pound;27.0 million under loan facilities A and B, together with a &pound;5.95 million VAT facility loan
within trade and other receivables.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Group accounts for its 50%
interest under the equity method: its share of the joint venture&rsquo;s loss before tax for the quarter (&pound;590k) is recognised against
the investment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The supply of equipment to the
joint venture was made at a loss, so no unrealised margin arises. To March 31, 2026 the joint venture had not commenced operations and
the investment was carried at cost. Facility A (&pound;20.0 million, Bank Rate plus 7.17%) is repayable in six-monthly instalments from
September 30, 2026 to March 31, 2032 and Facility B (&pound;7.0 million, Bank Rate plus 8.17%) from September 30, 2032 to March 31, 2035;
interest is paid at the end of each six-month interest period. The instalments due within twelve months (&pound;3.0 million) and the interest
accrued to June 30, 2026 (&pound;511k, received September 30, 2026) are presented as current.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Long-term purchase agreement</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The Group has entered into a long-term hydrogen purchase
agreement with HyMarnham Power Limited under which the Group has committed to purchase hydrogen produced by the joint venture over the
term of the agreement. The agreement includes minimum purchase commitments and pricing mechanisms governing the amounts payable by the
Group for hydrogen supplied.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Take-cost recovery mechanism</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Under the hydrogen purchase arrangements
with HyMarnham Power Ltd, the Group is subject to a take-cost recovery mechanism for the period from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2028. Where
revenues generated by the hydrogen production facility are insufficient to cover specified operating costs and financing costs, the Group
may be required to make additional payments to HyMarnham Power Ltd in accordance with the contractual mechanism. The arrangement is intended
to support recovery of specified costs during the initial operating period of the facility. An accrual was made for this in the period
of &pound;0.5 million.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Take-or-pay commitment</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Under the hydrogen purchase agreement with HyMarnham
Power Limited, the Group is subject to minimum hydrogen purchase commitments. Where the minimum contracted quantities are not taken, the
Group may nevertheless be required to make payments in accordance with the take-or-pay provisions of the agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">At 30 June 2026, the Group&rsquo;s
estimated minimum contractual commitment under these arrangements was &pound;100 million, of which &pound;nil is payable within one year
and &pound;100 million thereafter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The terms of the Group&rsquo;s borrowings,
including interest rates, security and covenants, are set out in note 23 of the Group&rsquo;s financial statements for the year ended March
31, 2026. Those terms are unchanged in the period. In June 2026 the Group entered into seven further asset-backed financing arrangements
for proceeds of &pound;7.2 million, repayable between 4 to 6.5 years at between 7.39% to 8.95%, secured on the related plant. The Group
complied with all covenants throughout the period and at June 30, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Convertible loan notes</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The term loan of &pound;27.0 million
was drawn in November 2025 and is repayable in semi-annual instalments from September 2026 to March 2032. Bank loans are repayable in
monthly instalments to September 2029. Asset-backed financing and sale-and-hire-back obligations arise on arrangements under which plant
is sold to a financier and hired back; control of the plant is retained, so the plant remains in property, plant and equipment and the
proceeds are secured borrowings at amortised cost. Seven further arrangements were entered into in June 2026 for proceeds of &pound;7.2
million. Current portions are the instalments contractually due within twelve months.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The convertible loan notes comprise
&pound;83 million of principal issued in three tranches bearing interest at 14%, 16% and 18%, rolled up to maturity on August 12, 2026.
The conversion features do not meet the fixed-for-fixed condition and are accounted for as a single embedded derivative at fair value
through profit or loss; the host liability is measured at amortised cost using effective interest rates of 16.7% to 19.2%. The fair value
of the conversion feature is determined from the expected conversion scenario, the equity value per ordinary share (&pound;185) and a
discount rate of 18%. The notes are classified as current at June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026 because they fell due within twelve months.
On August 12, 2026 the notes were converted into 717,621 ordinary shares (note 21).</P>

loans to the joint venture bear interest at floating rates, SONIA or Bank Rate plus a margin. The asset-backed financing and sale-and-hire-back
obligations bear fixed rates, are repaid in instalments, and were entered into between August 2024 and June 2026, and there has been no
significant change in market rates or the Group&rsquo;s credit risk that would cause a material difference.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>BALLARD POWER SYSTEMS INC.</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><B>Notes to the Unaudited Pro Forma Condensed
Combined Financial Information<BR>
 (Expressed in thousands of U.S. dollars, except as noted and for share and per-share amounts)</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">1.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">General Information and Description of the Transaction</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">On August 28, 2026, Ballard Power
Systems Inc. (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo; or &ldquo;Ballard&rdquo;) completed the acquisition (the &ldquo;Transaction&rdquo;) of GeoPura
Ltd. (&ldquo;GeoPura&rdquo;), a UK-based provider of zero-emission, hydrogen-based power solutions.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">GeoPura designs, manufactures,
and operates Hydrogen Power Units&trade;, or HPUs&trade;, that offers clean, low-noise, off-grid power. Utilizing Ballard fuel cell modules
at their core, these advanced systems convert hydrogen into clean electricity. GeoPura also produces green hydrogen, generated via electrolysis,
at its dedicated production facilities and transports it with the UK&rsquo;s largest compressed hydrogen distribution fleet.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Transaction was completed
for total preliminary consideration of $230.7 million consisting of (i) cash paid on closing of $104.7 million (or &pound;77.1 million),
(ii) contingent consideration of up to $37.3 million (or &pound;27.5 million), based on the achievement of certain project and revenue
milestones through December 31, 2028, payable at Ballard&rsquo;s discretion in either cash, Ballard common shares (priced at the 30-day
trailing VWAP before the payment date), or a combination thereof, which was fair valued using a probability-weighted, scenario-based
approach at $12.4 million (or &pound;9.2 million) on closing, (iii) 49.584 million newly issued Ballard common shares fair valued at
Ballard&rsquo;s closing day share price of $2.25 per share, or $111.6 million on closing, and (iv) 1.085 million Ballard restricted common
share units which will be settled 12-months post-closing fair valued based on Ballard&rsquo;s closing share price of $2.25 per share
discounted using an appropriate discount rate to $2.0 million on closing. On a pro-forma basis, former GeoPura shareholders hold approximately
14.1% of Ballard&rsquo;s outstanding common shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">2.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Basis of Presentation</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">These unaudited pro forma consolidated
financial statements as at and for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and for the latest fiscal year (the &ldquo;Pro Forma Financial Statements&rdquo;)
have been prepared by management of Ballard to give effect to the Transaction for the purposes of inclusion in the Business Acquisition
Report of the Company dated November 9, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The unaudited Pro Forma Financial
Statements present the pro forma consolidated financial position and results of operations of the combined company based upon the historical
financial statements of Ballard and GeoPura, after giving effect to the Transaction including the conversion and settlement of certain
of GeoPura&rsquo;s indebtedness on closing, payment of certain of GeoPura&rsquo;s transaction costs and change of control costs in connection
with the Transaction on closing, and other adjustments described in these notes, and are intended to reflect the impact of the Transaction
on Ballard&rsquo;s consolidated financial statements. The unaudited Pro Forma Financial Statements have been prepared in accordance with
IFRS and are presented in United States dollars unless otherwise disclosed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="padding-top: 1pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The unaudited pro forma consolidated
statement of financial position as at June 30, 2026 combines the unaudited historical consolidated statement of financial position of
Ballard as of June 30, 2026 and the unaudited historical consolidated statement of financial position of GeoPura as of June 30, 2026,
giving effect to the Transaction as if it had been completed on June 30, 2026.</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">These Pro Forma Financial Statements
utilize accounting policies that are consistent with those disclosed in the audited financial statements of the Company for the year ended
December 31, 2025, which were prepared in accordance with recognition and measurement principles of International Financial Reporting
Standards (&ldquo;IFRS&rdquo;) as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board (&ldquo;IASB&rdquo;). In preparing the Pro Forma
Financial Statements, a review was undertaken to identify accounting policy differences between the accounting policies used by Ballard
and those of GeoPura. The review of the material accounting policies of the Company and GeoPura was necessary to ensure comparability
in the Pro Forma Financial Statements. Based on our review, we believe the material accounting policies of GeoPura conform, in all material
aspects, to those of Ballard, with the exception of certain presentation and reclassification adjustments summarized below in note 3.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Transaction will be accounted
for using the acquisition method of accounting in accordance with IFRS 3, Business Combinations. As the accounting acquirer, Ballard will
account for the transaction by using Ballard&rsquo;s historical information and accounting policies and adding the assets and liabilities
of GeoPura at their respective fair values as of the completion date of the Transaction being August 28, 2026. The determination of the
fair value of the net assets acquired is preliminary, pending finalization of various estimates and analyses. Since these Pro Forma Financial
Statements have been prepared based on preliminary estimates of purchase consideration and fair values of assets and liabilities attributable
to the combination, the actual amounts eventually recorded for the Transaction may differ materially from the information presented.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Pro Forma Financial Statements
do not reflect the impact of possible revenue or earnings enhancements or cost savings from operating efficiencies or synergies. Also,
the Pro Forma Financial Statements do not reflect possible adjustments related to restructuring or integration activities that have yet
to be determined or transaction or other costs following the Transaction that are not expected to have a continuing impact on the business
of the combined company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-left: 0.25in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

(i) directly attributable to the Transaction, (ii) factually supportable, and (iii) with respect to the pro forma statements of income

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">4.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Preliminary Purchase Price and Fair Values of Assets Acquired
and Liabilities Assumed</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Transaction has been accounted
for using the acquisition method. The preliminary allocation of the purchase price was based on a preliminary assessment of the fair value
of identifiable assets, including assets acquired and liabilities assumed at the effective date of the Transaction, with the excess of
the purchase price over the estimated fair value being allocated to Goodwill.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Company has engaged independent
valuators to determine the fair value of the consideration paid and the fair value of acquired assets and liabilities assumed. However,
given the timing of the Transaction, the independent valuators have not completed the valuation, including the valuation of intangible
assets, and therefore the purchase price allocation is based on the Company&rsquo;s best estimate and is considered preliminary. As a
result, the purchase price allocation is preliminary and is subject to change once the final valuation of the consideration paid and the
identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed is completed.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The following is a preliminary
fair value estimate of the consideration paid and a preliminary fair value estimate of the identifiable assets acquired and liabilities
assumed by the Company in connection with the Transaction, reconciled to the estimated purchase price.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-left: 0.25in; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The
Transaction was completed for total preliminary consideration of $230.7 million consisting of (i) cash paid on closing of $104.7
million (or &pound;77.1 million), (ii) contingent consideration of up to $37.3 million (or &pound;27.5 million), based on the
achievement of certain project and revenue milestones through December 31, 2028, payable at Ballard&rsquo;s discretion in either
cash, Ballard common shares (priced at the 30-day trailing VWAP before the payment date), or a combination thereof, which was fair
valued using a probability-weighted, scenario-based approach at $12.4 million (or &pound;9.2 million) on closing, (iii) 49.584
million newly issued Ballard common shares fair valued at Ballard&rsquo;s closing day share price of $2.25 per share, or $111.6
million on closing, and (iv) 1.085 million Ballard restricted common share units which will be settled 12-months post-closing fair
valued based on Ballard&rsquo;s closing share price of $2.25 per share discounted using an appropriate discount rate to $2.0 million
on closing.</P>
